he_version: Midrash Tanhuma haKadum veHaYashan, S. Buber, 1885
en_version: Midrash Tanhuma, S. Buber Recension; trans. by John T. Townsend, 1989.
he: אמר בן עזאי בא וראה ענותנותו שלו, אבל הקב"ה אינו כן, אלא כשהזכיר מעשיו, מזכיר אחר כך שמו, שנאמר בראשית ברא אלהים.
en: Ben 'Azzay said: Come and see the humility of the Holy One. < The matter is comparable to > a king of flesh and blood who mentions his name < and >, afterwards mentions his creation.13Gk.: ktisma. But the Holy One is not like that. Rather, when he mentioned his works, < it was > afterwards < that > he mentioned his name. Thus it is stated (in Gen. 1:1, following the Hebrew word order): IN THE BEGINNING CREATED GOD.
